As a logistics employee at Samsung SDS in Tilburg, you will help get products from Samsung and other companies to the right place. You work in a team where there are regular staff meetings to get to know each other better.

Your tasks depend on the position. Primarily your tasks will be physical, so you need to be physicaly fit. You might be packing and preparing products like microwaves and tv's for shipment. Or you might be loading and unloading containers either with forklift or manually.

You will work two shifts: early (6 a.m. to 2:30 p.m.) or late (2:30 p.m. to 11 p.m.).

You will work between 30 and 37.5 hours per week. 

Do you want to contribute to Samsung's success? Then apply now!

You enjoy working in an international environment and love to work hard. At Samsung SDS, you'll help keep everything running smoothly in the warehouse.

What you bring:

- You have your own transportation to get to work. When you work in shifts, public transport is not possible
- You speak good English, which is helpful in this international environment.
- You are available full-time
- You are fit enough for physical work.
- You have your own accommodation.

It is nice if you are flexible. Sometimes we work until 1 a.m. or on weekends. But don't worry, that doesn't happen every week!

As a production employee at Vistaprint in Venlo, you work full-time in a modern production environment. You will work in a 4-shift schedule, between 37 and 40 hours a week. The atmosphere is informal and friendly. You get plenty of chances to learn new skills. Thanks to attractive shift allowances, your efforts are extra rewarded. You can start right away and housing is arranged for you. Perfect if you are looking for security and growth.
Your day starts with a short team meeting. Then you set up machines and monitor the production process. You make sure everything runs smoothly and step in if needed. You work according to clear guidelines and check the quality of the final product. You work closely with colleagues and regularly consult together. This way, you make sure every day runs well and you have a good day at work.
Do you like to solve problems and do you want to grow? Then this job is really for you! You work in a nice team and get the chance to develop yourself. Apply now and start your career at Vistaprint. Any questions? Just call, we are happy to help you! 🚀

- At least a high school working and thinking level

- You speak enough English

- Production experience is a plus, but s​tarters are welcome
